DemoRequest.title: DemoRequest
DemoRequest.description: A scheduled or requested platform demonstration from a prospective client or fleet partner.

name.description: Full name of the contact person

companyName.description: Company, establishment or fleet entity name

phone.description: Phone number with international country dialing code

interestedIn.description: Platform feature or product of primary interest

preferredDate.description: Requested meeting date in YYYY-MM-DD format

preferredTime.description: Requested meeting time slot (e.g., 11:00 AM AST)

message.description: Optional notes or fleet requirements description

status.description: Lifecycle state of the demo request

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when request was placed

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of most recent state update

confirmedAt.description: Timestamp when admin confirmed the meeting

confirmedBy.description: Email or ID of the admin who confirmed the meeting

meetingLink.description: Official video call URL provided by the administrator

adminNotes.description: Internal administrative notes or follow-up summary

updatedBy.description: Admin identifier responsible for the update

MailMessage.title: MailMessage
MailMessage.description: Email document dispatched via Firebase Trigger Email extension.

message.description: Email content payload containing subject, text, and html

demoRequestId.description: Associated demo request ID for correlation

/demoRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores inbound platform demo bookings and client inquiries.

/mail/{mailId}.description: Outbox collection triggering the Firebase Email extension.
